_comment: throw/catch sites in include/morph that no test can reach, with the reason each
scripts/check_error_path_coverage.py counts every throw statement and catch arm under
include/morph/**/*.hpp and cross-references each against the aggregated coverage LCOV's
line-hit counts. A raw throw-site count is not itself a target -- some sites are
defensive guards this repository has already decided are unreachable in practice, the
same discipline codecov.yml's own artifact audits apply to ordinary lines. The ones here
are those sites, and the reason has to say why rather than asserting it: 'a bare
Each entry is audited in both directions on every run, the same mechanism
scripts/branch_partial_allowlist.json uses: an entry whose site now has a nonzero hit
count fails the gate and must be deleted (a test now covers it); an entry whose source
text no longer exists, or is no longer a throw/catch site, fails too. `line` is a hint,
not the key -- the key is `source`, matched against the file's current contents, so a
stale line number does not silently keep suppressing the wrong statement after the file
